title: The Carrollian Superplane and Supersymmetry
summary: This note provides an intrinsic construction of the Carrollian superplane $Π\mathbb{S}\simeq \mathbb{R}^{2|4}$ as a supermanifold generalisation of the Carrollian plane. Moving away from the $c\rightarrow 0$ limit of relativistic spinors, we define Carroll spinors as sections of a degenerate Clifford module. We show that the Carrollian superplane is a principal $\mathbb{R}^{1|2}$-bundle.
